title: Digital Tyre Inflator - AIROJET 6000 LCV W
description: Wall Mountable - Heavy digital tyre inflator with big LCD display and pressure unit display.
subtitle: Wall Mountable - Heavy
fullDescription: Heavy duty wall mountable digital tyre inflator for buses and trucks. Features two digital readouts, big LCD display with LED backlight, pressure unit display to identify PSI or KG/CM2, and can be used for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV, mini truck, bus and truck.
features: Two digital readouts one for set pressure and other for tyre pressure
Big LCD display with LED back light to provide good visibility
Pressure unit display to identify PSI or KG/CM2
Display remain at same set pressure value even after power on-off cycle
Audible and visual end of the cycle signal indicators
LED indication for the status of operation
Soft touch and durable membrane keys suitable for outdoor
Separate keys for set pressure increment and decrement
Flat key for empty or puncture tyre
Toggle key for easy set pressure value 25/35 upto SUVs and 90/120/150 for heavy vehicles
Confirm to operate method for overpressure setvalue with display blink notification
Reset key to exit out of operation at any time
Can use for vehicle tyre ranging from two wheeler, car, SUV, mini truck, bus and truck

specifications.inputAirHose: 6mm x 2mtrs Black braided Hose with suitable fittings
specifications.inputFilter: 1/4 x 5 micron air filter with suitable fittings
specifications.outputAirHose: PVC braided hose suitable for 14K g/cm2 pressure with round head / hand held/clip on foot connector
specifications.keypad: Membrane Keypad suitable for outdoor application
specifications.display: 4 Digit 7 Segment LCD with Automatic LED backlight ON & OFF
specifications.dimensions: 275 x 140 x 275 mm (Control panel), 275 x 165 x 325 mm (Control panel with clamp), 435 x 315 x 435 mm (Packing)
